spans.s: लकचः [lakacḥ] लकुचः [lakucḥ], लकुचः A kind of breadfruit tree. -चम् The fruit of this tree.
लकुटः [lakuṭḥ], A club, cudgel; cf. लगुड.
लक्षक [lakṣaka], a. [लक्ष्-ण्वुल्] Indicating indirectly, expressing secondarily. -कम् One hundred thousand.
A mark, token, sign, indication, characteristic, distinctive mark; वधूदुकूलं कलहंसलक्षणम्
; अनारम्भो हि कार्याणां प्रथमं बुद्धिलक्षणम् Subhāṣ; उपकारापकारौ हि लक्ष्यं लक्षण- मेतयोः
;19.47; गर्भलक्षण Ś.5; पुरुषलक्षणम् 'the sign or organ of virility'.
A definition, accurate description; असाधारणधर्मो लक्षणम्; नामधेयेन पदार्थमात्रस्याभि- धानमुद्देशः, तत्रोद्दिष्टस्यातत्त्वव्यवच्छेदको धर्मो लक्षणम् Vātsyāyana Bhāṣya
A lucky or auspicious mark on the body (these are considered to be 32); द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेतः; लक्षणसंपन्नान्नां गवामधः सस्नौ
Any mark or features of the body (indicative of good or bad luck); क्व तद्विधस्त्वं क्व च पुण्यलक्षणा
A name, designation, appellation (oft. at the end of comp.); विदिशालक्षणां राजधानीम्
Excellence, merit, good quality; as in आहितलक्षण
(where Malli. renders it by प्रख्यातगुण and quotes Ak.: गुणैः प्रतीते तु कृतलक्षणाहितलक्षणौ).
An aim, a scope, an object.
A fixed rate (as of duties); नदीतीरेषु तद्विद्यात् समुद्रे नास्ति लक्षणम्
Indicatory characteristic; लक्ष्यते येन तल्लक्षणम्, धूमो लक्षणमग्नेरिति हि वदन्ति ŚB. on
A sexual organ; लक्षणं लक्षणेनैव वदनं वदनेन च

(In Rhet.) An indirect application or secondary signification of a word, one of the three powers of a word; it is thus defined: मुख्यार्थबाधे तद्योगे रूढितो$थ प्रयोजनात् । अन्यो$र्थो लक्ष्यते यत् सा लक्षणारोपिता क्रिया K.
. लक्षणा शक्यसंबन्धस्तात्पर्यानुपपत्तितः Bhāṣā P.; see S.
. also श्रुतिलक्षणाविषये च श्रुतिर्न्याय्या न लक्षणा ŚB. on
N. of Duryodhana's daughter. -Comp. -अन्वित a. possessed of auspicious marks; उद्वहेत द्विजो भार्यां सवर्णां लक्षणा- न्विताम्
. -कर्मन् n. definition. -ज्ञ a. able to interpret or explain marks (as on the body). -भ्रष्ट a. deprived of good quatities, ill-fated, unlucky; जायन्ते लक्षणभ्रष्टा दरिद्राः पुरुषाधमाः
. -लक्षणा = जहल्लक्षणा q. v.-संनिपातः branding, stigmatizing. -संपद् f. a multitude of marks.
लक्षणिन् [lakṣaṇin], a. Possessing marks &c. लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वाहं वचनं गृहे
Having good marks. -ण्यः A diviner; Buddh.
Conversant with, or able to explain or interpret signs.
One hundred thousand. (m. also in this sense); इच्छति शती सहस्रं सहस्री लक्षमीहते Subhāṣ.; त्रयो लक्षास्तु विज्ञेयाः
N. of one of the hells;
; रौरवे कूटसाक्षी तु याति यश्चानृतो नरः Mārkaṇḍeya P.; यदा रौरवादीन् स्मरन्नेव भीत्या Śaṁkarāchārya.
लक्षशस् [lakṣaśas], ind. By hundreds of thousands, i. e. in large numbers.
Seen, observed, marked, beheld; यैः सादिता लक्षितपूर्वकेतून् R.

Considered, regarded. -Comp. -लक्षणा indication based on indication, indicative indication, a secondary indication; इतरथा रथन्तरसामनि अध्यवसीयमाने ऋचा पदं लक्ष्यते पदेन साम सैषा लक्षितलक्षणा स्यात् ŚB. on
. It should be observed that लक्षितलक्षणा is a दोष and hence inadmissible.
लक्षिन् [lakṣin], a. (-लक्षिणी f.) Having good marks or signs; लक्षिण्यो रत्नभूताश्च देवदानवरक्षसाम्
To point to, refer or allude to; इयं कथा मामेव लक्षीकरोति Ś.7.
Ā. (लक्षते, लक्षित) To perceive, apprehend, observe, see -
To notice, observe, see, find, perceive; आर्यपुत्रः शून्यहृदय इव लक्ष्यते
To mark, denote, characterize, indicate; सर्वभूतप्रसूतिर्हि बीजलक्षणलक्षिता
To indicate secondarily, mean or signify in a secondary sense; यथा गङ्गा- शब्दः स्रोतसि सबाध
लक्षयति तद्वत् यदि तटे$पि सबाधः स्यात्तत् प्रयोजनं लक्षयेत् K.
Possessed of good or auspicious marks, fortunate, lucky.

N. of a son of Dasaratha by his wife Sumitrā. [He was so much attached to Rāma from his very childhood that he became ready to accompany him during his travels, and took no small part in the several events that took place during the fourteen years of Rāma's exile. In the war of Laṇkā he killed several powerful demons, but particularly Meghanāda, the most heroic of the sons of Rāvaṇa. He was at first mortally wounded by Meghanāda by means of a magical weapon, but was restored to life by Suṣeṇa by means of the medicinal durgs fetched by Māruti. One day, Time in the disguise of a hermit came to Rāma and said that he who should happen to see them converse in private should be immediately abandoned, which was agreed to Laksmana on one occasion intruded on their privacy and made the word of his brother true by throwing himself into the Śarayū; (see
-95.). He married Urmilā by whom he had two sons, Aṅgada and Chandraketu.]; अथ लक्ष्मणानुगतकान्तवपुः Śi.9.31.
णा A goose (सारसा); 'हंसस्य योषिद्वरटा सारसस्य तु लक्ष्मणा ।' Śi.4.59.
A mark, sign, token. -Comp. -प्रसूः N. of Sumitrā, mother of Laksmaṇa.
A mark, sign, token, characteristic; प्रकटमलिनलक्ष्मा मुष्टपत्रावलीकैः Śi.11.3;8.41;
A speck, spot; मलिनमपि हिमांशोर्लक्ष्म लक्ष्मी तनोति Ś1.2;
The chief, principal (प्रधान); 'लक्ष्म चिह्ने प्रधाने च'
; शोकं दैन्यं च दुःखं च प्राजहात् पुत्रलक्ष्मणि
Fortune, prosperity, wealth; सा लक्ष्मीरुपकुरुते यया परेषाम्
; मातर्लक्ष्मि तव प्रसादवशतो दोषा अमी स्युर्गुणाः Subhāṣ;
Beauty, loveliness, grace, charm, splendour; lustre; श्यामं सदापीच्यवयो$ङ्गलक्ष्म्या स्त्रीणां मनोज्ञं रुचिरस्मितेन

The goddess of fortune, prosperity and beauty, regarded as the wife of Viṣṇu. (She is said to have sprung from the ocean along with the other precious things or 'jewels' when it was churned for nectar by the gods and demons.); इयं गेहे लक्ष्मीः
; प्रत्यब्दं पूजयेल्लक्ष्मीं शुक्लपक्षे गुरोर्दिने । नापराह्ने न रात्रौ च नासिते न त्र्यहस्पृशि ॥ Skanda P.

Royal or sovereign power, dominion; (oft. personified as a wife of the king and regarded as a rival of the queen); तामेकभार्यां परिवादभीरोः साध्वीमपि त्यक्तवतो नृपस्य । वक्षस्यसंवट्टसुखं वसन्ती रेजे सपत्नीरहितेव लक्ष्मीः ॥
N. of the eleventh digit of the moon.
Comp. ईशः an epithet of Viṣṇu.
a prosperous or fortunate man. -कल्पः a particular period of time.
(in music) a kind of measure.-नाथः an epithet of Viṣṇu. -निकेतनम् the bathing with fragrant myrobalan powder. -निरीक्षित a. favoured by Lakṣmī, rich; लक्ष्मीनिरीक्षिताः क्षिप्रं भजन्ते चक्रवर्तिताम्

a wealthy man. -पुष्पः a ruby. -पूजनम् the ceremony of worshipping Lakṣmī (performed by the bridegroom in company with his bride after she has been brought home). -पूजा the worship of Lakṣmī performed on the day of newmoon in the month of Āśvina (chiefly by bankers and traders whose commercial or official year closes on that day). -फलः theBilva tree. -रमणः an epithet of Viṣṇu. -वसतिः f. 'Lakṣmī's abode', the red lotus-flower. -वारः Thursday. -विवर्तः change of fortune. -वेष्टः turpentine.-सखः a favourite of Lakṣmī -सनाथ a. endowed with beauty or fortune.
सहजः, सहोदरः epithets of the moon.
N. of the horse of Indra.-समाह्वया N. of Sītā; L. D. B.
Possessed of good fortune, fortunate, lucky.
Wealthy, rich, thriving; लक्ष्मीवन्तो न जानन्ति प्रायेण परवेदनाम् Udb.
Handsome, lovely, beautiful.-m. The bread-fruit tree.
To be looked at or observed, visible, observable, perceptible; बभ्रमुस्तदविज्ञाय लक्ष्यं पतनकारणम्
Indicated or recognizable by (with instr. or in comp.); दूराल्लक्ष्यं सुरपतिधनुश्चारुणा तोरणेन
To be known or found out, traceable; यमामनन्त्यात्मभुवो$पि कारणं कथं स लक्ष्यप्रभवो भविष्यति
To be expressed or denoted indirectly.
To be regarded or considered as. -क्ष्यः N. of a magical formula recited over weapons; Rām.
क्ष्यम् An aim, a butt, mark, target, mark aimed at (fig. also); उत्कर्षः स च धन्विनां यदिषवः सिध्यन्ति लक्ष्ये चले Ś. 2.5; दृष्टिं लक्ष्येषु बध्नन्
;5.49; लक्ष्यं चतुर्विधं ज्ञेयं स्थिरं चैव चलं तथा । चलाचलं द्वयचलं वेधनीयं क्रमेण तु ॥
The thing defined (opp. लक्षण); लक्ष्यैकदेशे लक्षणस्यावर्तनमव्याप्तिः Tarka K.
An indirect or secondary meaning, that derived from लक्षणा q. v.; वाच्यलक्ष्यव्यङ्ग्या अर्थाः K.
A pretence, sham, disguise; इदानीं परीक्षे किं लक्ष्यसुप्तमुत परमार्थ- सुप्तमिदं द्वयम्

A lac, one hundred thousand. -Comp. -अक्षिहरणम् the carrying off of a prize. -अलक्ष्य a. scarcely visible. -क्रमः a. the method or order of which is (indirectly) preceptible, as a dhvani. -ग्रहः taking aim. -भेदः, -वेधः hitting the mark; अपतित्वा नु चकार लक्ष्यभेदम्
. -वीथिः f. the visible road (ब्रह्मलोकमार्ग). -सिद्धिः the attainment of an object. -सुप्त a. feigning sleep. -हन् a. hitting the mark. (-m.) an arrow.
लाकाक [lākāka], a. (-की f.) [लोके विदितः प्रसिद्धो हितो वा ठण्]
General, common, usual, ordinary, vulgar; लौकिकानां हि साधूनामर्थं वागनुवर्तते
Of every-day life, generally accepted, popular, customary; जायापती लौकिकमेषणीयमार्द्रा- क्षतारोपणमन्वभूताम्
Temporal, secular (opp. आर्ष or शास्त्रीय); न पैतृयज्ञियो होमो लौकिके$ग्नौ विधीयते
Not sacred, profane (as a word or its sense); वाक्यं द्विविधं वैदिकं लौकिकं च T. S.; (see Mbh. quoted under लोक 8).
Belonging to the world of; as in ब्रह्मलौकिक.-काः (pl.)
Ordinary men, men of the world.

The human race, mankind. -कम् Any general or worldly custom. -Comp. -अग्निः fire not sanctified by rituals.-ज्ञ a. knowing the ways of the world, acquainted with worldly customs; वनौकसो$पि सन्तो लौकिकज्ञा वयम् Ś.4. -न्यायः a general rule or maxim.
लाकुटिक [lākuṭika], a. (-की f.) [लकुटः प्रहरणमस्य ठक्] Armed with a club or cudgel. -कः A sentinel, watchman;
One who is acquainted with marks or signs.
Having a secondary sense, used in a secondary sense (as a word, as distinguished from वाच्य and व्यञ्जक q. q. v. v.); स्याद्वाचको लाक्षणिकः शब्दो$त्र व्यञ्जक- स्त्रिधा K.
Secondary, inferior; साक्षात् सुधांशुर्मुखमेव भैम्या दिवः स्फुटं लाक्षणिकः शशाङ्कः

A kind of red dye, lac; (largely used by women in ancient times as an article of decoration, especially for the soles of the feet and lips; cf. अलक्त; it is said to be obtained from the cochineal insect and from the resin of a particular tree); निष्ठ्यूतश्चरणोपभोगसुलभो लाक्षारसः केनचित् (तरुणा) Ś. 4.5.; Ṛs.6.14; लाक्षागृहानलविषान्नसभाप्रवेशैः

The insect which produces the red dye,-Comp. -तरुः, वृक्षः N. of a tree, Butea Frondosa. -प्रसादः, -प्रसादनः the red Lodhra tree (the infusion of its bark is used to fix colour). -रक्त a. dyed with lac.
Relating to, made of, or dyed with lac.
